jobs.title: Machine Learning Systems Engineer - Video Computer Vision
jobs.description:
The incredible potential of multimodal foundation models and large language models has unlocked machine learning applications that were previously thought infeasible. The Video Computer Vision (VCV) group is looking for a highly motivated and skilled Machine Learning Systems Engineer to help us ship cutting-edge computer vision technology on Apple devices.  
  
The VCV organization has pioneered groundbreaking features like FaceID/FaceKit, Gaze/Hand Gesture Control, Body Tracking, and 2D/3D Scene Understanding fundamentally changing how millions of users interact with technology. We seamlessly balance research and product requirements to deliver pioneering, Apple-quality experiences. By innovating across the full stack and partnering closely with hardware, software, and AI teams, we shape future products and bring our architectural vision to life.  
  
**Description**  
  
As a member of the Video Computer Vision team, you will work across the stack to transform promising research projects into refined products that ship to our customers. You will build software infrastructure to deliver multimodal context to models and optimize the software harness and the model for efficient on-device deployment. Partnering closely with algorithm researchers, you will also participate in post-training model alignment and evaluation.","responsibilities":"Develop on-device software that bridges multimodal AI models and computer vision technologies with production systems deployed across Apple devices.  
  
Optimize on-device inference latency, memory footprint, and computational efficiency of CV/ML models.  
  
Benchmark, profile, and evaluate the power consumption and thermal performance of models running on Apple silicon.  
  
Engage with cross-functional teams to understand and influence requirements, brainstorm the solution space, and propose, design and implement debuggable and maintainable Computer Vision systems meeting requirements.  
  
Design experiments and evaluations to understand quality and on-device deployment tradeoffs, driving informed system design decisions.  
  
Debug concurrent systems on embedded devices via a variety of existing tools and techniques; develop innovative debug tools and visualizations when existing ones don't fit the bill.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Programming experience with Swift and familiarity with CoreML, CoreFoundation, and RealityKit frameworks.  
  
Fundamental knowledge of real-time video pipelines, image transformations, and rendering loops.  
  
Experience optimizing models for neural network accelerators (e.g., Apple Neural Engine or mobile GPUs).  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related discipline, and 3+ years of relevant industry experience.  
  
Strong ML fundamentals.  
  
Proven track record of writing high-quality production code for shipped on-device CV/ML features deployed on embedded platforms  
  
Solid understanding of operating system fundamentals and extensive programming experience in Python and C++.  
  
Hands-on experience with PyTorch and familiarity with the end-to-end ML lifecycle (data preprocessing, training, evaluation, and edge deployment).  
  
Experience with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) pipelines to adapt vision and multimodal foundation models for specialized, on-device downstream tasks.  
  
Robust foundational understanding of machine learning architectures, specifically Multimodal LLMs and the integration of ML components into complex production systems.  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: iOS Software Engineer
jobs.description:
People at Apple don't just build products - they craft the kind of experience that has revolutionized entire industries. The diverse collection of our people and their ideas inspire innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could do here! Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. Apple Pay helps people easily and securely make purchases in stores and on the web. Wallet is the home for your boarding passes, event tickets and loyalty cards, along with your digital ID, car keys, home keys, and transit cards. With Connected Cards, you can also securely connect your bank accounts to your cards in Wallet to view your balances and transactions, and help you be more informed about your finances. We’re solving some of the most interesting problems in payments and finance, and we’re seeking a software engineer to bring their experience and insight to help us build the next generation of features that will improve the lives of millions of our customers, every day.  
  
**Description**  
  
You will join a team of talented software engineers, building native Apple Pay and Wallet experiences for Apple platforms, such as iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS. You will build well-architected, thoughtfully designed solutions that solve problems for both the users of our products and the merchants and issuers who consume our APIs. You’ll also be improving and maintaining the existing features built by our team over the years. You will be contributing to the operating systems running on billions of devices across the world, so your solutions will need to be secure, resilient, and work at an incredible scale.. You’ll need to be comfortable collaborating with different teams within Apple, such as human interface designers, product experts, quality engineers, and senior leadership, while being a credible and respected voice advocating for both engineering and our customers.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience with software development for Apple platforms (e.g. iOS, macOS, visionOS)  
  
Experience with the Swift or Objective-C programming languages  
  
Experience working in large codebases  
  
Demonstrated history of creating well-crafted, maintainable applications or frameworks  
  
Industry experience in e-commerce, banking, financial services, payments, or other relevant fields  
  
A strong understanding of what makes a good customer experience  
  
Knowledge of computer security or privacy fundamentals  
  
Comfortable communicating ideas and concepts to a variety of audiences  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Strong software engineering skills  
  
Experience creating software for native (non-web) platforms  
  
Critical thinking and problem solving skills  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. jobs.description:

Meet the Team
  
  
Mergers& Acquisitions IT team develops software platform to integrate acquired companies, accelerating operational synergy and time-to-value. We use secure coding practices, protect user privacy, and follow software development standards. We are looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys accelerating acquisition integration through automation, scalable software, and strong engineering practices! By joining this team, you will build relationships with a diverse set of global audiences and work with cutting-edge AI technologies to seamlessly integrate products, customers, bookings etc from acquired companies to Cisco.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
You will lead the end-to-end technical integration of acquired entities, transforming disparate legacy stacks into cohesive, high-performance systems. You will champion an"AI-Nativ" engineering approach, using GenAI and agentic workflows to automate migrations and accelerate synergy realization while ensuring architectural integrity.
  
  

* Design and develop modular, API-first solutions that bridge acquired entities with Cisco’s enterprise stack, specifically targeting complex order-to-cash and subscription systems.
* Deploy GenAI/LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent systems to automate due diligence, data mapping, and migration testing.
* Maintain technical standards (security, scalability, performance) across hybrid environments. Use design thinking to eliminate technical debt and ensure future-proof integrations.
* Lead AI maturity assessments and implement LLMOps (observability, latency/cost optimization, and evaluation pipelines) to ensure production-grade reliability.
* Improve the software development lifecycle and advance best practices in agile engineering.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of software engineering experience in complex, large-scale enterprise environments, including proficiency in Java/J2EE, Spring, TypeScript, Python, Snowflake, and Oracle DB.
* Experience designing, developing, and deploying full stack solutions, RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed applications, and leading projects from implementation to delivery.
* Strong experience with cloud-based and relational databases (e.g., Elasticsearch, Vector DB, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and building solutions on AWS, Azure, and on-premises environments.
* Expertise in Cloud and DevOps development using Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Jenkins CI/CD.
* Experience with AI-native engineering, including agentic frameworks, LLMs, RAG, multi-agent orchestration, and specialized AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor).
* Experience in M, digital transformation, or quote-to-cash integrations.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Knowledge of production monitoring, incident response, postmortems, and root cause analysis.
* Deep architectural intuition with an API-first mindset.
* Ability to thrive in high-velocity environments, navigating ambiguity to deliver innovative solutions.
* In-depth conceptual and practical knowledge in primary technical job family and knowledge of related technical job families; has worked extensively with a range of technologies.
* Strong background in object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and software development principles.
* Experience applying spec-driven development or similar approaches to improve software quality and delivery.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer, App Intelligence
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
Join the App Intelligence team and help redefine what a deeply personal and integrated assistant can be. As part of the Siri organization, you will help shape one of the world's most widely used AI assistants, powered by our next generation of Apple Intelligence - with capabilities like personal context understanding and on-screen awareness, built with privacy from the ground up.  
  
We are engineers, scientists, and problem solvers working to bring smarter, faster, and more natural interactions to millions of users worldwide. As a Software Engineer on our team, you will build the on-device runtime foundation that powers Siri, enabling seamless, intelligent, and secure experiences with direct, meaningful impact across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS.  
  
**Description**  
  
App Intelligence is the on-device system that turns app capabilities into things a user can simply ask for - and makes the assistant reliable enough to be trusted with them. We partner closely with the team that builds Siri's planning and execution engine, and we own the app side of that partnership: what apps can offer, how they express it, and whether the resulting experience is good enough to trust. As a platform engineer, you will build the on-device software this depends on and make the resulting experiences reliable and fast. This is early work. How apps should best expose themselves to an assistant is still an open question - you will help answer it by designing the interfaces, proving them out with real app partners, and iterating as we learn. Expect real ambiguity, and expect to form your own view of the right architecture and defend it with working software and measured results.","responsibilities":"Design, develop, and maintain the robust on-device runtime platform that enables end-to-end Siri experiences.

Contribute to the shared evaluation and telemetry loop that proves whether a platform change improved user outcomes.  
  
Design and evolve the interfaces between the runtime and the model - tool and function-calling schemas, context construction, and validation of model output - so that what the planner decides is executed reliably.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Proficiency with Swift and Xcode, with experience building applications for Apple platforms.  
  
Experience designing and developing systems that are efficient in resource-constrained environments - latency, memory, and power budgets on device.  
  
Experience working on AI software runtimes or agent orchestration frameworks, or on voice assistants / conversational AI systems leveraging LLMs.  
  
Experience building software features driven by LLMs, including designing tool and function-calling interfaces, constructing context, and validating model output.  
  
Experience with API design or framework development, including key software components and APIs used cross-functionally across different applications and platforms, and versioning and compatibility of interfaces that shipped clients depend on.  
  
Experience with evaluation or telemetry infrastructure that measures the end-to-end quality of LLM-driven features (e.g., Python, SQL, dashboards).  
  
Experience leading the design of complex features or driving architectural decisions across teams (for candidates at the more senior end of the range).  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience, with 5+ years developing and shipping production software.  
  
Strong proficiency in C++, Swift, or Objective-C, with a solid understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.  
  
Strong understanding of OS internals, concurrency, multithreading, and memory management.

Experience with system performance analysis and optimization techniques.

We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

### **About the Team**

We’re part of Plaid’s Data organization, building models that help millions of people better understand and grow their financial lives. We apply machine learning to high-impact product challenges, working across product areas to develop solutions that create meaningful customer value.

We focus on credit, building models to the standards required in lending and supporting the next wave of cash-flow-based underwriting. We value technical expertise, creativity, user empathy, and teamwork, and we’re guided by Plaid’s principles of impact, growing together, openness and positivity, and inventing tomorrow.

  

### **About the Role**

As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Credit team, you’ll design, build, and deploy scalable machine learning solutions that support LendScore and the future of cash-flow-based underwriting. You’ll work across the full model lifecycle—from experimentation and offline training through production serving and monitoring—and partner with engineers and cross-functional teams to turn data and new modeling approaches into reliable systems.

In this role, you will:

* Develop and productionize AI and machine learning models, from offline training through online serving and ongoing monitoring.
* Experiment with modeling approaches and strategies for credit use cases, balancing model performance with the requirements of lending environments.
* Partner with engineering teams to ingest signals and build the systems needed to bring models into production.
* Contribute to both 0-to-1 problems and the scaling and improvement of established solutions.
* Collaborate with teams across Plaid to help define the machine learning roadmap.
* Dive into data and use evidence-based analysis to guide day-to-day decisions.

### **What Excites You**

* Building products that can empower millions of people through well-known and emerging fintech applications.
* Experimenting with modern machine learning techniques on meaningful credit and lending problems.
* Working across the full lifecycle of machine learning systems, from exploration to production and ongoing improvement.
* Taking on both greenfield challenges and opportunities to scale solutions that are already delivering value.
* Joining a high-ownership, bottom-up team where your work can shape the roadmap and drive business impact.

### **What Excites Us**

* 2+ years of experience training and serving AI or machine learning models in a production environment.
* Experience in fintech lending and a strong understanding of how models are built and used in lending.
* Experience building or working with data-intensive backend applications in large, distributed systems.
* Ability to code and iterate independently using data infrastructure tools such as Python, Spark, Jupyter notebooks, and standard machine learning libraries.
* A track record of taking ownership and driving projects to business impact.
* Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
* Master’s degree or equivalent work experience in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a closely related field.
* Nice to have: Experience in data analytics or data engineering.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

### **About the Role**

As a Data Scientist on the Credit team, you’ll apply quantitative analysis and deep credit expertise to help lenders make better use of cash flow insights. * Build and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes using tools such as dbt.
* Develop metrics, alerts, and dashboards to monitor production machine learning model performance.

* Own the process of developing hands-on recommendations for incorporating cash flow insights into lending decisions, using best practices for account-level decisioning.
* Improve customer adoption of Plaid Insights through custom analysis tailored to each customer’s needs.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on credit insights and credit policy implementation, supporting Data Science, Engineering, and Go-to-Market partners.
* Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and data visualization to develop models and actionable insights.
* Identify useful signals that can inform machine learning models.
* Inform and influence Product and Engineering teams through clear analysis and presentations.

### **What Excites You**

* Applying data science and credit expertise to real-world lending decisions.
* Working with Plaid’s unique financial data to uncover emerging credit risk signals and create useful customer insights.
* Helping lenders make more informed decisions with cash flow data and account-level recommendations.
* Partnering across Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Go-to-Market to turn analysis into customer and product impact.
* Working on high-impact problems that can improve financial access and outcomes.

### **What Excites Us**

* 2–5 years of industry experience in a financial services Data Science role.
* Deep familiarity with SQL and Python.
* Deep understanding of credit risk and the development of underwriting models.
* Hands-on credit expertise building and maintaining credit policies for lenders.
* Knowledge of the lending lifecycle and how to optimize each step, including marketing, acquisition, customer management, and collections or recoveries.
* Demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions.
* Nice to have: Experience building data pipelines and automating ETL processes with dbt or similar tools.

We’re part of Plaid’s Data organization, building models and insights that help millions of people better understand and grow their financial lives. We use Plaid’s unique financial data to help lenders make more informed decisions and build better credit experiences.

We partner across data science, engineering, product, and Go-to-Market to turn complex data into practical customer recommendations and scalable solutions. We value technical rigor, creativity, user empathy, and teamwork.

  

### **About the Role**

As a Data Scientist on the Credit team, you’ll apply quantitative analysis and deep credit expertise to help lenders make better use of cash flow insights. You’ll work across customer problems, credit policy, and data products—translating Plaid’s data into recommendations and insights that drive business impact and inform product direction.

Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:

* Deep-dive into model performance for clients, triage issues, and identify opportunities to improve outcomes.
* Analyze Plaid’s unique data to identify emerging credit risk signals and build and evaluate credit retrospectives.
* Create tailored recommendations for clients based on their data and Plaid’s insights.
* Build and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes using tools such as dbt.
* Develop metrics, alerts, and dashboards to monitor production machine learning model performance.

In this role, you will:

* Own the process of developing hands-on recommendations for incorporating cash flow insights into lending decisions, using best practices for account-level decisioning.
* Improve customer adoption of Plaid Insights through custom analysis tailored to each customer’s needs.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on credit insights and credit policy implementation, supporting Data Science, Engineering, and Go-to-Market partners.
* Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and data visualization to develop models and actionable insights.
* Identify useful signals that can inform machine learning models.
* Inform and influence Product and Engineering teams through clear analysis and presentations.

* Applying data science and credit expertise to real-world lending decisions.
* Working with Plaid’s unique financial data to uncover emerging credit risk signals and create useful customer insights.
* Helping lenders make more informed decisions with cash flow data and account-level recommendations.
* Partnering across Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Go-to-Market to turn analysis into customer and product impact.
* Working on high-impact problems that can improve financial access and outcomes.

* 2–5 years of industry experience in a financial services Data Science role.

* Deep understanding of credit risk and the development of underwriting models.
* Hands-on credit expertise building and maintaining credit policies for lenders.
* Knowledge of the lending lifecycle and how to optimize each step, including marketing, acquisition, customer management, and collections or recoveries.
* Demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions.
